summary_rationale: Yash Highvoltage is India's only independent pure-play condenser-graded transformer bushing specialist, protected by 8-to-10-year utility qualification barriers, >96% repeat order rates, and a structural shift toward dry-type RIP bushings (86% of H1 FY27 revenue). Revenue compounded ~38% CAGR over FY22-FY26 to Rs 235.1 Cr and accelerated 95% YoY in H1 FY27 to Rs 194.5 Cr with 28.1% EBITDA margins, Rs 760 Cr order book visibility, and Rs 95 Cr net cash. Key watchpoints are H2 FY27 commissioning of indigenous RIP core manufacturing at Jarod, receivable days (up from 47 to 66 days in H1 FY27), and scaling US/European exports beyond 6% of revenue.
